title: Compatible open ordinary-tensor stalk rings
statement: In the restricted and ambient pullback squares of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], at a point z of the restricted source, the four stalk rings R0,A0,B0,C0 are respectively isomorphic to R1,A1,B1,C1 by ring equivalences commuting with all four displayed algebra maps. The A and C equivalences are pinned to the inverse open inclusion stalk maps, transporting the input endpoint by the point equality from hj.

source.place: Open restriction of stalks; Mathlib Scheme.Opens.stalkIso and stalkIso_inv, Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp, stalkMap_congr and stalkMap_congr_hom; SingleComplexBaseChange.exists_tensorMap.

proof.text: Compose the four open-inclusion stalk isomorphisms with stalkCongr for the endpoint equalities supplied by hj and the restriction maps. This constructs the ring equivalences and the two specified A and C normalizations.

For f use its open restriction stalk square followed by stalkMap_congr along the input point equality. For g first transport along sq0.w, commute the open stalk iso past stalkCongr, then use the resLE stalk square and stalkMap_congr at the restricted base point. stalkSpecializes_comp identifies the composite transports.

Use the square hj and the restriction square of f-prime to prove the two maps to C are compatible. The two defining restrictions in exists_tensorMap identify them with the required tensor algebra maps.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_openOrdinaryTensor_stalk_ring_coordinates
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV'))
    (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) :
    let R₀ := R (f ∣_ V) j z
    let A₀ := A j z
    let B₀ := B (f' ∣_ V') z
    let C₀ := C z
    let R₁ := R f g' z.val
    let A₁ := A g' z.val
    let B₁ := B f' z.val
    let C₁ := C z.val
    letI := leftAlgebra (f ∣_ V) j z
    letI := rightAlgebra (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z
    letI := (tensorMap (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z).toAlgebra
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z.val
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z.val
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z.val).toAlgebra
    ∃ (eR : R₀ ≃+* R₁) (eA : A₀ ≃+* A₁) (eB : B₀ ≃+* B₁) (eC : C₀ ≃+* C₁),
      eA.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ A₀) = (algebraMap R₁ A₁).comp eR.toRingHom ∧
      eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ B₀) = (algebraMap R₁ B₁).comp eR.toRingHom ∧
      eC.toRingHom.comp ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
        (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))) =
        ((algebraMap (A₁ ⊗[R₁] B₁) C₁).comp
          (algebraMap A₁ (A₁ ⊗[R₁] B₁))).comp eA.toRingHom ∧
      eC.toRingHom.comp ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) =
        ((algebraMap (A₁ ⊗[R₁] B₁) C₁).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).comp eB.toRingHom ∧
      eA.toRingHom =
        (((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).stalkIso (j z)) ≪≫
          X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq
            (congrArg (fun k : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ X => k z) hj))).hom.hom ∧
      eC.toRingHom = ((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').stalkIso z).hom.hom
